claims.location: ## Kanotoiwa Iriguchi is the start of the approach paragraph 1
claims.claim: The published outline uses a Koiwa-bound bus from Musashi-Itsukaichi to Kanotoiwa Iriguchi. Walk toward Kanotoiwa, cross the first bridge and follow the forest road, then take the mountain path beside a small stream. The publisher describes roughly 15 minutes on each of the road and path; treat these as reference estimates. Shoji-iwa is not the Kanotoiwa sightseeing feature or an interchangeable entrance to neighbouring crags.
